title: quercus edulis
intro: Quercus edulis, commonly known as the California live oak, is a species of evergreen tree that belongs to the beech family. The health benefits of Quercus edulis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may help to lower blood pressure, reduce swelling, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Quercus edulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
